cto.description: The highest-ranking technology executive in the organization. Defines the long-term technological strategy, drives technical innovation, and aligns software tools and infrastructure with the company's business objectives.

level_1_executive_leadership.description: High-level leaders who report directly to the CTO. They translate strategic vision into operational guidelines, manage global budgets, and lead the major branches of the technology department.

roles.responsibilities: The CTO's operational right hand. Responsible for people management, budgeting, hiring, and ensuring software delivery meets established deadlines.
Responsible for the global technical design of systems. Defines technologies, languages, and architectures to ensure platforms remain scalable and stable.
Guarantees cybersecurity, data privacy, and legal or regulatory security compliance across the company's entire infrastructure.

roles.role: Head of Data / Chief Data Officer
roles.responsibilities: Leads the strategy for collecting, storing, and analyzing Big Data, as well as training Artificial Intelligence and machine learning models.
Responsible for keeping servers and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) operational to eliminate system downtime.

level_2_operations_management.description: Directors responsible for overseeing specific business verticals or product areas. They coordinate multiple engineering teams and serve as a bridge between executive leadership and tactical teams.

roles.responsibilities: Oversee groups of technical teams organized by specific products or platforms (e.g., Director of Mobile Applications).
Leads the overall quality control strategy, ensuring strict methodologies are in place to mitigate bugs before software releases.
Define the features and the 'what' to build based on market and user needs, working hand-in-hand with engineering.

level_3_team_leadership.description: Middle management operating in day-to-day project development. They utilize agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and directly manage engineering talent and code quality.

roles.responsibilities: A role focused on people management. They conduct performance reviews, guide career paths, and resolve organizational roadblocks for the team.
Technical anchors for the team. They make software design decisions at the code level and mentor less experienced developers.

level_4_individual_contributors.description: Technical specialists and engineers who execute the actual operational work: writing code, performing individual tests, automating deployments, and analyzing data.

roles.responsibilities: Program and build user interfaces (Frontend) as well as data layers, APIs, and internal servers (Backend).
Execute manual tests and develop automation scripts to validate that code operates exactly as designed.
Automate software deployments to production environments and continuously monitor the performance of live applications.
Build data pipelines for processing raw data and design advanced analytics or machine learning algorithms.
